sloka: प्रहृष्टा हरयः तत्र समुदैक्षन्त विस्मिताः ।तत् च अस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा ज्ञातीनाम् शोक नाशनम् ॥४-६७-३०॥
transliteration: prahṛṣṭā harayaḥ tatra samudaikṣanta vismitāḥ ।tat ca asya vacanam śrutvā jñātīnām śoka nāśanam ॥4-67-30॥

translations.english: The monkeys looked at him and were amazed, happy to see him roaring and shining in brilliance.
